integrated_findings.claim: P0 caller/trigger populations are internally consistent and current names structurally resolve; TLP/set partitions reconcile exactly.
Hash equality is comparator-sensitive: md5(prosrc) yields 16 matches while md5(pg_get_functiondef()) yields 0, so no canonical historical hash method is established by coincidence alone.
Bounded current candidate and frozen P0 sets are not interchangeable: 75=27 overlap+48 outside, while 38=27 overlap+11 outside-pattern.
Timing partitions and nonnegative request ordering are internally consistent, but chunk additivity fails as a general invariant and causal performance remains unproven.
Recorded identity/component partitions reconcile and show no equal non-null pairs, but canonical authority linkage and material execution independence are not established.
Existing evidence surfaces and stable duplicate-body grouping support reuse-first verification; no runtime repair or duplicate deletion is justified.
